items: Five faces the moodboard never got

Worldbuilding and Plans ingestion: still open

NEXT MILESTONE UNNAMED. Both v0.5 deliverables shipped (campaigns entities on 2026-08-03/04, the proficiency training tracker recorded in CHANGELOG.md), so v0.5 is closed and nothing has been declared after it. Naming what comes next is Kane’s, and the number below cannot move honestly until something does.

Basis for the 55 percent hold: the figure is NOT re-derived here. It was anchored 2026-07-06 and the two deliverables that closed since were already counted toward it when it was set. Re-anchoring the date without moving the number records that the staleness was looked at on 2026-08-24 and that the number was left deliberately, rather than leaving a date that implies nobody has checked in seven weeks (bar-raise observability-02 / strategic-kill-this-01).

actions.title: Write the stale flag and the error text back into the status record when the dashboard write throws, instead of only printing it.
Name the real scientific-library consumers in the pin file, not the two globe chains that never import it.
Document the second vendored graphics file with its matching revision beside the three-dimensional library entry.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Refuse the dismissal and hook-pin writes when the preceding read failed, instead of writing an empty map over the store.
Give the session token a server-checked identifier so signing out can revoke it.
Mint a separate high-entropy machine secret alongside the human passphrase.
Settle whether the drift auto-fix leg of the nightly sweep still runs, and restore it or drop its stale pointer.
Name what follows v0.5, folding the character sheet, the fog and the living world into it, or say in the spec that the project is past numbered milestones.
Precompute a faction, region and tag index once before the render loop so the related-entity pass stops rescanning every entity per page.
Batch the pin-moves and forge-pending reads the way every sibling list loader in the same file already does.
Extract the self-contained page renderers and the pricing and character-sheet subsystems out of the build script, leaving the gate family in a smaller file.
Adopt a version marker on new or changing keyspaces so a schema change stops needing a bespoke hand-run migration.
Give the gate family a fixture-driven test file.
Lift the gate family into a checks module in that same change.
Replace the sequential per-key reads in the pin-moves and forge-pending endpoints with a batched read.
Raise the inventory-mirror write failure to error level, matching every other storage failure in the same file.
Write the missing characters, monsters and maps jobs, or remove the three topic slots the handler still calls live.
Log the caught error in the three throttle functions and keep the documented fail-open behaviour.
Reword the gated southern-continent page's next-steps line so it stops naming the image tool.
Surface the two known silent-drop conditions in the portrait prompt tooling instead of relying on remembered ritual.
Measure one shop rotation and one multi-tick day advance against the current 332 shops, and cap or background the pass if it is trending past half the processor limit.
Record a retention rule for the session-zero questionnaire files, or reduce the respondents to initials.

closedLog.evidence: GET /api/answers takes ?qids= as an unconditional intersection with the fail-closed PUBLIC_Q allow-list, so it can only narrow; resolveRestocks prunes a shop item that is both gone and off the shelf; both verified by isolated logic tests; commit 174f90f1

decided under D52: shopstate and shopledger become one combined record per shop, which removes the two-put desync as a side effect; recorded in PROJECT_SPEC.md section 6 dated 2026-09-02; the migration itself is queue row gnosis-shop-economy-kv-migration-2026-09-02

measured: about 332 shops in the vault, so a rotation pass is a few thousand cheap operations on a manually triggered dungeon-master endpoint, well inside the processor budget; cut for now with the count on record, revisit if the shop count grows several-fold
the three GET handlers (gameday, dm-dismissed, hook-pins) log a key-value read failure the way their siblings already did, and the two paginated loops report a skipped-row count; commit 174f90f1
CLAUDE.md's webhook table and tools/discord/post.mjs both named a channel the log moved off on 2026-07-06; corrected to the live one; commit 174f90f1
release.ps1 asserts the payload-leak checks against the local build right after the build and before the commit, and the live answers probe attempts a rollback before throwing; commit 174f90f1
the release notification's web request carries a ten-second timeout, the one call in the release path that had no bound; commit 174f90f1
tools/statblocks/render.py and tools/route/build_route.py write through a read-back verify helper, replacing five direct writes with no truncation check on this mount; commit 174f90f1

the public-only warning in tools/ingest-answers/collect.mjs prints immediately before the final summary as well as early, which is where the routine's own documentation points a reader; commit 174f90f1

unactionable as written: every tool that calls a gated endpoint (forge-drain, continuity, kv-snapshot, the two ingest tools, answer-check) reads the password file directly and sends it as a header on every call; none has an interactive prompt or a reusable session to fall back from, so there is no code the finding describes. A review re-raises it with a named file if a prompt is ever added.
